title: Dataset 2 (ToN-IoT network, deduplicated): pre-registered confirmation of Fed-MediShield bsc_7
written: 2026-10-09, after the clean calibration controls and the trigger selection, before any attacked ToN-IoT run

data.preparation: data/prepare_ton_iot.py --dedup (addendum A29); 51 features; grouped 80/20 split; 8 clients, Dirichlet alpha 0.5, seed 42

detector: bsc_7 exactly as on CICIoMT (history off, client profiles, breadth k = 3, first-episode revocation, held rounds); no setting re-tuned for ToN-IoT.
clean_model_check: Clean controls (logs/tond_cal): validation accuracy 81.1-84.9%, macro-F1 65.1-66.6%; LOSO clean FPR 0/0/0%.

trigger.selection: logs/select_trigger_ton.py (rule 2 of the CICIoMT selection; candidate set widened to non-contiguous sets after 0/96 contiguous candidates were eligible, before any attacked run); worst conditional clean triggered->Normal rate 0.0%, unconditional 0.54%

attack: target Normal (class 0), --poison-rate 0.5 --malicious-ratio 0.25 (2 attackers of 8), constant trigger above, every round from round 1, --loss-adjustment logit --logit-tau 0.5, 15 rounds
procedure: 1 shadow (no filtering) attacked runs on development seeds 43 and 46 with calibration logs/tond_cal (captures the development attack)
2 recalibrate logs/tond_cal2 from the clean controls and both shadow captures (no training, no inference)
3 live development gate on seeds 43 and 46 (criteria of AMENDMENT_live_development_gate.json); if it fails, steps 4-5 do not start and the failure is reported
4 confirmation seeds 93-97: MediShield clean + attacked (--live-gate-dir logs/tond_devgate), FedAvg clean + attacked, oracle residual
5 baselines Krum, median, trimmed mean (f = 2), RFA, Fed-ADH on the same seeds (descriptive)
per_seed_criteria: identical to PREREGISTRATION_phase2d_bsc5_histoff.json per_seed_criteria (final-ASR reduction, exposure, detection, first detection, honest FPR in attacked and clean runs, clean F1 and worst-class recall vs FedAvg, attacked F1 vs oracle); inconclusive if FedAvg attacked final ASR < 50% or the oracle run is missing; a stop after 3 consecutive invalid rounds fails
decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every conclusive seed passes every criterion AND at least four of five seeds are conclusive.
rule: No setting, threshold, seed or criterion changes after any attacked ToN-IoT data are seen.
